findings.description: Replacing the exception with a warning allows requests with an invalid CA bundle path to continue and potentially succeed over an existing pooled TLS connection.
findings.rationale: After a Session successfully requests an HTTPS origin, make another request to that origin with verify pointing to a nonexistent CA bundle. The changed code warns instead of aborting; if the established TLS connection is reused, no new certificate loading occurs and the request succeeds despite the invalid verification configuration. Previously, this configuration reliably raised OSError before sending the request.
